I've saved Hollis's note and replied to them in the DM.

The file says to use it only in Hollis's DMs with me, and never in another member's conversation or in a channel. I didn't put it in GBrain, because GBrain is shared and other people can read it.
- **GBrain check:** I searched GBrain first. It had nothing about this dock, only an older note about Marrow Fieldworks handoffs. GBrain's search is keyword-only, so it may have missed notes worded differently.
- **Reply:** I confirmed in the DM that I'd noted the dock and will keep it between us. My first try to send that reply failed with a "member not found" error, so I posted it straight into the DM conversation instead.

Hollis said no action was needed, so I did nothing else.
